display_long_description:
The sun is setting. The forest is waking up. Grab your axe — build a shelter before nightfall, or become prey.

Titan Forest: Survival Shooter is an open world survival adventure set in a vast, hostile wilderness. Chop trees, forge weapons, and fight the creatures that rule the night — every decision matters.

FACE THE TITAN One colossal final battle. Defeat the Titan to become the strongest survivor — and unlock the next level of danger and reward
[media]

RIDE THE WILDERNESS Saddle up and travel on horseback. Scout new territory, outrun predators, and reach distant resources before dark.
[media]

HUNT — OR BE HUNTED Humanoid enemies stalk the treeline. Monstrous worm beasts erupt from the earth. Track them, fight them, grow stronger.
[media]

BUILD YOUR SAFE HOUSE Place walls, floors, and more — construct your shelter piece by piece before dark, then defend it when the forest comes for you.
[media]

EXPLORE A HUGE OPEN WORLD Cross a massive landscape of dense forests, plains, and hidden valleys. Every region hides danger and reward.
[media]

CRAFT, GEAR UP, SURVIVE Cut wood and forge axes, tools, and weapons with a hands-on inventory. Upgrade to face deadlier enemies.
[media]

KEY FEATURES:

1. Huge open world on foot or horseback
2. Hands-on crafting and inventory
3. Piece-by-piece base building
4. Humanoid enemies and worm monsters
5. Weapon forging and upgrades
6. Epic Titan boss battle
